p: Fairy Lake Botanical Garden (仙湖植物园)
160 仙湖路 Xianhu St, 深圳市 Shenzhen
160 Fairy Lake Road, Liantang, Luohu District (罗湖区莲塘仙湖路160号)
09:00-17:00 (Tue to Fri), 09:30-17:30 (weekends and public holidays), no entry during last 30 minutes, closed on Mondays
